---
output: html_document
---

<style type="text/css">
.main-container { max-width: 1800px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }

/* Containers */
.gray { background-color:#7e8687; border-radius: 5px; padding: 20px; }
.blue { background-color:#9dc9d1; border-radius: 5px; padding: 20px; }

/* Typography */
.blue, .blue p, .blue li { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; }
.section-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 10px 0; }
.rule { border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.25); margin: 14px 0; }

/* Nav */
.site-nav { font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.site-nav a { text-decoration: none; }
.site-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* Links */
a[target="_blank"]::after { content: ""; }

/* --- NEW: Home icon grid --- */
.home-grid{
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(120px, 1fr));
  gap: 22px;
  align-items: start;
  justify-items: center;
  padding: 10px 0;
}

.home-tile{
  text-align: center;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

.home-img{
  width: 170px;
  height: 170px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  border: 3px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
}

.home-label{
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 900px){
  .home-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(120px, 1fr)); }
}
@media (max-width: 450px){
  .home-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
</style>

<div class="gray">
<div class="blue">

<div class="home-grid">
  <a class="home-tile" href="about/">
    <img class="home-img" src="BackmanTalia.jpg" alt="About">
    <div class="home-label">ABOUT</div>
  </a>

  <a class="home-tile" href="publications/">
    <img class="home-img" src="publications.png" alt="Publications">
    <div class="home-label">PUBLICATIONS</div>
  </a>

  <a class="home-tile" href="news/">
    <img class="home-img" src="news.png" alt="News">
    <div class="home-label">NEWS</div>
  </a>

  <a class="home-tile" href="tbd/">
    <img class="home-img" src="mentees.jpg" alt="MENTEES">
    <div class="home-label">MENTEES</div>
  </a>
</div>

</div>
</div>
